about: Shared lesson plans for Brain Boost Time(r). To add one, append it to this list after checking it (see the README).

plans.name: Standard 60-minute lesson
plans.about: A starter, teaching, practice and a brain break, then a plenary.

plans.name: Group work rounds
plans.about: Three rotations with quick changeovers, for stations or jigsaw groups.

plans.name: Exam practice
plans.about: Reading time, writing in blocks, a stretch, then checking.

plans.name: Focus and break (25/5)
plans.about: Two rounds of 25 minutes of focus with 5-minute breaks, for self-study.

plans.name: Think, pair, share
plans.about: Quiet thinking, discussion in pairs, then sharing with the class.
